_comment: Parameters of the Great Wave generator (src/gwave). Same file -> same mesh and animation. Defaults marked PENDING are working choices to re-evaluate against the painting and motion tests.

base_contour.comment: final-pose section = official large-form base contour (PENDING user confirmation of r=150 and the left-end reading)

n_u.comment: samples along the section (U). 421 x 201 = 84,621 vertices, same order as the existing Unity cache (85,120)

n_v_center.comment: rows in the constant-section middle part

flank_mode.comment: Current default: end caps taper a full 3-D sheet while preserving the print-camera cavity and contour. The alternative 'regress' remains experimental because its projected flanks can fill the cavity and cause frame jumps.

crest_half_length_H.comment: lift_clip: half width of the constant centre section; narrowed after oblique-view comparison to shorten the straight overhanging lip

taper_length_H.comment: lift_clip: curved end-cap width on each side, in H; total crest-line width remains 2*(crest_half_length_H+taper_length_H) = 4.4 H

flank_plateau.comment: regress: fraction of the half length around the middle that is fully developed

flank_development_power.comment: regress: development factor A(u) = 1 - smoothstep^power (smaller power = the curl dies out sooner)

flank_height_start.comment: regress: from this fraction outwards the section is also scaled down in Z, reaching still water at the ends

flank_back_shift_H.comment: spec 7e (PENDING): regress: the ends trail this far behind the middle in X (crescent crest line in plan view); 0 = straight crest line

left_extension_H.comment: spec 7b (PENDING): horizontal length of the smooth extension of the back beyond the left frame edge down to still water

left_slope_chord_pct_h.comment: chord (percent of image height) used to read the back's end tangent for the C1 extension

right_flat_H.comment: flat trough run added in front of the wave (hem on Z=0)

right_completion_reach_H.comment: spec 7c: the occluded / completed end of the inner arc is re-drawn as a Bezier that lands horizontally on Z=0 this far beyond the contour's end

density_gain.comment: adaptive U sampling: density = 1 + gain * min(curvature/curv_ref, 1)

density_curv_ref_per_H.comment: curvature (rad per H) at which the sampling density saturates

swell_amplitude_H.comment: start pose: gentle swell height (M1 needs front slope < 30 deg; the user asked to start from a calm surface)

swell_sigma_H.comment: start pose: Gaussian half width of the swell

front_length_ratio.comment: arc length of the front side in the start pose relative to the final pose

head_start_length_ratio.comment: start arc length of the head (crest -> tip -> underside) relative to its final length: the lip grows out of the crest during overhang / curl-in, so o(t) increases

lag_angle_max.comment: near-immediate head angle response; with the separately controlled height and delayed length this gives monotone head-tip turning

lag_length_max.comment: delayed head-tip / underside lengthening; paired with lag_angle_max and explicit height keyframes to preserve the rise

lag_inner_deepest.comment: lag mask value at the inner-arc deepest point (1 = as late as the tip)

lag_trough.comment: lag mask value where the inner arc meets the trough

hold_frames.comment: static frames after the final pose (tests need >= 30)

frame_curl_start.comment: internal morph-time knot; the measured phi peak / visual curl-in is near frame 210 with the current lag settings

curl_start_fraction.comment: morph parameter at the curl-in start = tau_onset + fraction * (1 - tau_onset)

height_keyframes_H.comment: independent crest-height controller in H units, monotone cubic between these measured working-pose keys; first and final values exactly match the generated section. The animation uses this curve without running the older shape recipe.

xc_travel_H.comment: PENDING: horizontal travel of the crest during the whole motion (the Houdini reference travels about 3.5 H; the painting frame only reaches -0.86 H)

xc_travel_power.comment: x_c(t) = final - travel * (1 - t/T)^power : starts moving, decelerates to rest

blend_path.comment: project-relative, generated Blender scene; ignored by Git

cache_path.comment: project-relative per-frame vertex cache read by the Mesh Cache modifier; ignored by Git
